Native-safe VehicleCommandCenter (contract rule 7): the web component (../components/VehicleCommandCenter, 389 lines) is a separate conversion-loop file; rather than transplant a partial port, the inline native VehicleCommandCenter preserves the {vehicle, state} prop contract and surfaces the real data — name (display_name || vin), a success/neutral state badge, model · vin, an updated-at freshness line (timeAgo ported from the web component L33-42), battery_level % tinted emerald>50 else amber (mirrors the web header L264), and lock/charge/climate/sentry chips from VehicleState — plus an explicit pending note that the full interactive command grid (search, favorites, collapsible categories, command mutations, dialogs, toasts) lives in the dedicated command center. The web header's unit-formatted rated_range/inside_temp (which need useUnits) are deferred to that component's own port; this page itself carries no units, so no unit conversion was introduced.

Browser-only behaviour made native-safe (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) react-router-dom Link/URL navigation has no in-app router on the native web-parity surface -> the '/command-history' target is preserved on the optional onNavigate prop and fired from a link-styled Pressable. (b) document.title for usePageTitle is feature-detected (present on react-native-web, absent on bare native). No localStorage, fetch/useEffect data-loading, or other DOM dependencies are used by this page.

No DOM elements (div/span/h1/p), no react-router-dom, no react-i18next, no lucide-react, no Recharts/Leaflet, and no @/ web UI modules in the native output — only react-native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/Animated/ActivityIndicator/StyleSheet), @tanstack/react-query, the ported web-parity request client + MetricCard, and the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) clean; npm run lint -- --quiet clean; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles green.
